audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated Levels 1-4 as Lissandra while the content layer and the packet levelChart both call them Skill. The lane is an even dodge-fight until Frozen Tomb.
audit.why: Darkin Daggers reach 900 to Lissandra's 725 Q, and Eviscerate is a 11/10/9/8/7s dash that heals her packmates — nothing before level 6 gives Lissandra a kill button.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Skill at 5/10 with whys rewritten to argue the even case; levels 6 onward stay Lissandra.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text swapped Naafiri's slots: it called The Call of the Pack her R and described a 'W dash'. R is Hounds' Pursuit; W is The Call of the Pack and is untargetability, not a dash.
audit.why: Per the kit, W (26/24/22/20/18s) makes her untargetable and empowers the pack; R (110/95/80s, 900 range) is the lock-on dash and recasts once for a shield.
audit.corrected: Named the real slots in spikes[1].text, mid, whys[4] and wants.foe[1], and added the R recast shield as the reason to hold the tomb.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated that Naafiri has three separate untargetability windows, and breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it.
audit.why: W, E and R all carry the untargetable flag; the R recast also grants a shield. Burst spent into any of them is wasted, which is exactly the mistake the page invited by saying 'commit on its cooldown' with no timers.
audit.corrected: Stated Hounds' Pursuit at 110s rank 1 / 80s maxed with its shielding recast, Eviscerate at 11s, and The Call of the Pack at 26s, and told the player to hold the tomb for the second R cast.

audit.why: report[8] already prescribes anti-heal, which the missingInteractions 'needs-antiheal' rule requires against Eviscerate's pack healing; only the pronoun needed fixing.
